text:
Greetings coordinators,

The arrivals lead recorded a question about shade areas after lunch, and I wanted to pass it on. Please reassure the team that we will keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk attentive to comfort, quiet handling, and steady supervision throughout each handoff. The welfare coordinator should continue to watch for signs of stress and confirm that each animal has access to water, relief breaks, and a calm resting space whenever conditions allow.

Please also remember that booking notes must be reviewed with care so that carrier checks, feeding guidance, and pickup arrangements remain consistent from start to finish. For rabbit cases, <<FACT F064>>. For small dog cases, <<FACT F056>>. These notes help us provide patient service without causing confusion for handlers or travelers, and they should be followed exactly as issued.

If any coordinator hears a concern from the arrivals area, please share it promptly so we can respond with calm, humane support and keep the process smooth for the travelers and their animals. Our work remains most effective when we stay clear, courteous, and fully aligned with the welfare steps already in place.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
